capabilities: Add tasks, milestones, deadlines, key dates and locations with one-line quick add
Drag, resize, link and select bars on a Canvas-like timeline
Show slack, critical path and saved-plan vs reality comparisons
Export print-ready PDF, PNG, SVG, CSV or Markdown tables
Import plans from spreadsheets, CSV, Markdown tables or Mermaid
extras: All data stays in the vault as readable YAML in a Gantt/ folder; no accounts and no network requests, so it works with git and Obsidian Sync. Features can be switched off without losing data.
problem: Obsidian has no timeline view, so project plans with phases, deadlines and dependencies are hard to see, adjust and print from plain notes.

relations.evidence: With Pocket Watch installed, edit a project there and choose this timeline

summary: Gantt chart planner that keeps projects as Markdown notes with YAML, with one-line quick add, Canvas-like dragging, dependencies and print-ready export.
